visualBaseline: Kitchen V8, with the V5 fridge used only as the dimensional-detail reference and Frank's supplied shelf image used only as the wall-detail reference

surfaceRecipe: white lid highlight and lower bevel

preservationRules: Every Kitchen V8 asset other than the fridge remains byte-identical.
The V8 room shell, bin, counters, oven, sink, table, chair, pet bowl, cupboard and porthole layers remain unchanged.
The shelf is a separate transparent wall child and is never baked into the room shell or fridge sprite.
The shelf and fridge receive the same whole-bay horizontal translation without rescaling.
Keeper art, runtime sprites, Final art, registers and live manifests remain unchanged.
acceptanceRules: The refrigerator remains inside one 21-lp bay and keeps the V8 bottom-centre anchor and 52-lp foot line.
The refrigerator top contains no Kitchen V6 countertop wood colours.
The refrigerator has multiple distinct light and shadow tones across the enamel body so it does not read as flat.
The shelf stays inside one 21-lp bay, has transparent gutters, and its lowest opaque pixel remains above the refrigerator.
Moving the refrigerator to bays 2, 5 or 8 moves the shelf by the identical delta.
The final four logical pixels of foreground floor remain identical to the V7 shell.
